checks.name: shared launcher excludes exclusive maintenance and concurrent launch is allowed
exclusive lock excludes another process and flag survives owner exit
host inherits shared lock after launcher parent releases its descriptor
unsafe parameter logging rejects before maintenance flag or admission mutation
tampered signed approval rejects before admission/HBA changes
normal executor rotates credentials, drains idle Native backend, holds exact four sessions
renew checks actual barrier with current physical sessions
normal resume commits RESUMING before opening, clears claims only at CLOSED
normal window can restart with higher epoch and block without restoring admission
takeover drains old maintenance and hands both claims to higher epoch; old credentials denied
SIGKILL of real controller process leaves durable launcher block and closed databases
takeover COMMIT acknowledgement loss preserves committed successor and blocks
same committed takeover pair is ACK-only and never creates another successor
fresh request takes over lost successor at higher epoch and normal resume works
full catalog drift rejects normal resume and keeps both admissions closed
HBA tampering is detected on renewal and does not release startup flag
partial normal restore failure preserves RESUMING, closes gates and disables writers
credential staging failure occurs before any password ALTER
Business helper drift rejects before fresh controller authority is seeded
lost CLOSED COMMIT ACK keeps flag and isolation despite committed CLOSED
fresh closed-ack bootstrap observes exact CLOSED without replay or flag release
wrong CLOSED epoch rejects without granting restore authority
wrong resume journal binding rejects before credential rotation
CLOSED helper execute ACL excludes runtime, issuer, executor and PUBLIC
historical CLOSED ACK does not clear a later active window claim
NOT_CLOSED after failed complete_resume never authorizes write replay
wrong service scope refuses controller seed in CLOSED ACK bootstrap
partial password rotation retains prepared secrets and exact per-role progress
prepared credential file drift prevents resume and never marks delivery ready
secrets absent from durable journals; generated credential files are 0600
